S.FORM: = Kobah = Gaga mniq Nantowseyn Jnaysyang ka alang kobah. 56 sapah ka kneegu na sapah, 141 hiyi ka kana knhbragan na hiyi. Tnpusu seejiq o mangal 74% niqan 104 hiyi sp, rahuq na uxay tnpusu seejiq o mangal 26% niqan 37 hiyi koia. Kana ka kleegan seejiq ga, Tayal67%, Seejiq/Seediq/Seejiq/Seejiq/Sediq4%, Bunun1%, Cou1%. Hangan alang Qalang Kobah Tukubeycu na alang Mnllutuc Biru Moan (Kiya ka Tayal kana ka tnualang hini). Nniqan niya Nato keyng Jinay go Hwasyang cwen qalang Kobah. Knlbangan Wa mniq Hwasyang cwen hnruwan hidaw tuhunac, pnswayan cida Yayung Peykang mi Yayung Hwasyang na dxral baraw pryaxan hidaw. Nniqan lnglingay Haipa 1700 m na dxral dwiyaq. Quri ppanan rulu Mriq rulu: Tayhoku mi Takaw Kwotaw→ Kwotaw 3 go Fomosa kawsu kongru→ Kwotaw 6 go Sweysaryeyn kawsu kongru→Hori, muru elu Tay 14 seyng (Puwu kong-ru) mquri paran mmusa Ppwaluk tyeyn-cu patas qtan alang Teyncu patas pkla nniqan alang. Klwanan sediq Tayal Sduwi na kari saya Skari kari Tayal, ska kari Telu. Snlhayan snhiyan Kiristo kyo: Cweyrwan Kiristo Cyoro Kyokay, Cweyrwan Sin Yasu Kyokay. Quri pplahan mi sanan rmiwaw
